*FORM CLEAN_SELECTION.                                      
**                                          &
*  DATA : L_VBELN TYPE VBRK-VBELN,                                
*         L_FKART TYPE VBRK-FKART,                           &nbs
*         L_WERKS TYPE VBRP-WERKS.                           &nbs
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : IT_BSET, IT_BSET[].                                 &n
*                                          &n
*  LOOP AT IT_BSID.                                    
*    IF P_CRD EQ 'X' AND IT_300[] IS NOT INITIAL.                        &n
*      READ TABLE IT_300 WITH KEY  BUKRS = IT_BSID-BUKRS                     &nb
*                                   BELNR = IT_BSID-BELNR  &
*                                   GJAHR = IT_BSID-GJAHR  &
*                                   BINARY SEARCH    &n
*                                   TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.  
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                               
*        DELETE IT_BSID.                               
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
**   유효하지 않은 전표 라인 삭제                                 &
*    "과세표준액이 10원 이상인데 세액이 0원이고 세율이 0이 아닌 라인 삭제(2022.02.11 개선)                    &nbs
*    CLEAR IT_BSET9.                                   
*    READ TABLE IT_BSET9 WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_BSID-BUKRS                        &
*                                 BELNR = IT_BSID-BELNR    &
*                                 GJAHR = IT_BSID-GJAHR    &
*                                 BINARY SEARCH.      &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      IF IT_BSET9-HWBAS >= '0.10'.                            &nbs
*        IF IT_BSET9-KBETR <> 0 AND IT_BSET9-HWSTE = 0.                    
*          DELETE IT_BSET9 WHERE BUKRS = IT_BSID-BUKRS                     
*                            AND BELNR = IT_BSID-BELNR       &nbs
*                            AND GJAHR = IT_BSID-GJAHR.       &nb
*          CONTINUE.                               
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      CONTINUE.                                   
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
**   기발행 CHECK.                                    &nbs
*    CLEAR IT_EXT_D.                                   
*    READ TABLE IT_EXT_D WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_BSID-BUKRS                        &
*                                 BELNR = IT_BSID-BELNR    &
*                                 ZGJAH = IT_BSID-GJAHR    &
*                                 BINARY SEARCH.      &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      DELETE IT_BSID.                                 
*      CONTINUE.                                   
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
**   역분개전표 제외                                     
*    CLEAR IT_BKPF.                                   &
*    READ TABLE IT_BKPF WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_BSID-BUKRS                        &n
*                                BELNR = IT_BSID-BELNR     &
*                                GJAHR = IT_BSID-GJAHR     &
*                                BINARY SEARCH.       &
*    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.                                 
*      DELETE IT_BSID.                                 
*      CONTINUE.                                   
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
**     대금청구문서                                    &
*      IF NOT S_VBELN[] IS INITIAL.                            &n
*        IF IT_BKPF-AWTYP EQ 'VBRK' AND IT_BKPF-AWTYP IN S_VBELN.                   &
*        ELSE.                                 &nb
*          DELETE IT_BSID.                             
*          CONTINUE.                               
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*      IF IT_BKPF-AWTYP EQ 'VBRK'.                             &n
*        CLEAR : L_VBELN, L_FKART, L_WERKS.                         &n
*        L_VBELN = IT_BKPF-AWTYP.                            &nbs
*        IF S_FKART[] IS NOT INITIAL.                          &n
*          SELECT SINGLE FKART INTO L_FKART                       &nbs
*            FROM VBRK                            
*            WHERE VBELN EQ L_VBELN                        &
*              AND FKART IN S_FKART.                      &n
*          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                           
*          ELSE.                               &nb
*            DELETE IT_BSID.                           
*            CONTINUE.                             
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*        IF S_WERKS[] IS NOT INITIAL.                          &n
*          SELECT SINGLE WERKS INTO L_WERKS                       &nbs
*            FROM VBRP                            
*            WHERE VBELN EQ L_VBELN                        &
*              AND WERKS IN S_WERKS.                      &n
*          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                           
*          ELSE.                               &nb
*            DELETE IT_BSID.                           
*            CONTINUE.                             
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    CLEAR : IT_BSET.                                  
*                                          &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_BSID TO IT_BSET.                             &nb
*                                          &n
*    IT_BSET-BUKRS = IT_BSET9-BUKRS.                               &nb
*    IT_BSET-DOC_BUPLA = IT_BSET9-BUPLA.                               
*    IT_BSET-BELNR = IT_BSET9-BELNR.                               &nb
*    IT_BSET-GJAHR = IT_BSET9-GJAHR.                               &nb
*    IT_BSET-MWSKZ = IT_BSET9-MWSKZ.                               &nb
*                                          &n
*    IF IT_BSET9-SHKZG EQ 'S'.                               &nbs
*      IT_BSET-HWBAS = IT_BSET-HWBAS + ( IT_BSET9-HWBAS * -1 ).                    &n
*      IT_BSET-HWSTE = IT_BSET-HWSTE + ( IT_BSET9-HWSTE * -1 ).                    &n
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      IT_BSET-HWBAS = IT_BSET-HWBAS +  IT_BSET9-HWBAS.                        &
*      IT_BSET-HWSTE = IT_BSET-HWSTE +  IT_BSET9-HWSTE.                        &
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    COLLECT IT_BSET. CLEAR IT_BSET.                              &nbs
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.                    " CLEAN_SELECTION                 &n
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------                              &nb
**&      Form  SELECT_KNA1                               &nb
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------                              &nb
*FORM SELECT_KNA1 .                                     &nbs
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LS_KNVK      LIKE KNVK,                            
*         LT_KNVK      LIKE LS_KNVK OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,              &nbs
*         LV_SMTP_ADDR LIKE ADR6-SMTP_ADDR,                          &
*         L_DATETO     LIKE ADRC-DATE_TO,                       &
*         L_NATION     LIKE ADRC-NATION,                       &n
*         LS_KADRC     LIKE ADRC.                        &nb
*                                          &n
**  DATA : LT_MANA LIKE ZDTV3T_CUST_MANA OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                      &
**         lt_vat  LIKE zdtv3t_cust_vat OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                 &n
*                                          &n
*  DATA : BEGIN OF LT_KNA1 OCCURS 0,                              
*           BUKRS LIKE T001-BUKRS,                          
*           KUNNR LIKE KNA1-KUNNR,                          
*         END OF LT_KNA1.                             &
*                                          &n
*  CHECK NOT IT_BSET[] IS INITIAL.                                
**                                          &
*  CLEAR : IT_KNA1, IT_KNA1[], L_DATETO, L_NATION.                            &n
*  SELECT B~KUNNR B~NAME1 A~BUKRS B~STCD1 B~STCD2 B~J_1KFTBUS                         &nbs
*         B~J_1KFTIND B~J_1KFREPRE B~ORT01 B~STRAS                        &
*         B~XCPDK B~STCD3 B~ADRNR                            
*    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_KNA1                           &
*    FROM KNB1 AS A INNER JOIN KNA1 AS B                          
*      ON A~KUNNR = B~KUNNR FOR ALL ENTRIES IN IT_BSET                      
*   WHERE A~KUNNR EQ IT_BSET-KUNNR                                
*     AND A~BUKRS EQ IT_BSET-BUKRS.                              
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : "LT_MANA, LT_MANA[],                                 &
*          "GT_VAT, GT_VAT[],                            &nb
*          LT_KNA1, LT_KNA1[].                            &n
*  IF IT_KNA1[] IS NOT INITIAL.                                &n
**    SELECT BUKRS                                   &n
**           KUNNR                              &n
**           IP_EMAIL1                             &nbs
**           IP_PERSNAME1                             &
**           IP_TELNO1                             &nbs
**           IP_HPNO1                              
**      FROM ZDTV3T_CUST_MANA                                
**      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_MANA                         
**      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN IT_KNA1                            &nb
**      WHERE BUKRS EQ IT_KNA1-BUKRS                             
**      AND KUNNR EQ IT_KNA1-KUNNR                             &n
**      AND SEND_FLG EQ 'X'.                              &n
*                                          &n
**    SELECT BUKRS                                   &n
**           KUNNR                              &n
**           BUPLA                              &n
**      FROM ZDTV3T_CUST_VAT                                
**      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE GT_VAT                         &
**      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN IT_KNA1                            &nb
**      WHERE BUKRS EQ IT_KNA1-BUKRS                             
**      AND KUNNR EQ IT_KNA1-KUNNR.                             &
*                                          &n
**    SORT LT_MANA BY BUKRS KUNNR IP_EMAIL1.                           &nbs
**    SORT GT_VAT BY BUKRS KUNNR.                              &n
*                                          &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_KNA1[] TO LT_KNA1[].                             
*                                          &n
*    SORT LT_KNA1 BY BUKRS KUNNR.                              &n
*    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_KNA1 COMPARING ALL FIELDS.                      &n
*                                          &n
***    CLEAR : IT_VAT, IT_VAT[].                               &n
**    LOOP AT LT_KNA1.                                  
**      LOOP AT LT_MANA WHERE BUKRS EQ  LT_KNA1-BUKRS                       
**                         AND KUNNR EQ LT_KNA1-KUNNR.          &
**        IT_VAT-BUKRS = LT_MANA-BUKRS.                           &nbs
**        IT_VAT-KUNNR = LT_MANA-KUNNR.                           &nbs
**        IT_VAT-IP_EMAIL1 = LT_MANA-IP_EMAIL1.                          &n
**        IT_VAT-IP_PERSNAME1 = LT_MANA-IP_PERSNAME1.                         &n
**        IT_VAT-IP_TELNO1 = LT_MANA-IP_TELNO1.                          &n
**        IT_VAT-IP_HPNO1 = LT_MANA-IP_HPNO1.                          &nbs
**                                          &
**        CLEAR GT_VAT.                               &
**        READ TABLE GT_VAT WITH KEY BUKRS = LT_KNA1-BUKRS                    &n
**                                   KUNNR = LT_KNA1-KUNNR  
**                                   BINARY SEARCH.    
**        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
**          IT_VAT-BUPLA = GT_VAT-BUPLA.                          
**        ENDIF.                                 &
**        APPEND IT_VAT. CLEAR IT_VAT.                           
**      ENDLOOP.                                   
**    ENDLOOP.                                     
*                                          &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
**                                          &
**  DELETE IT_VAT WHERE BUKRS EQ SPACE                              &n
**                AND KUNNR EQ SPACE.                    &nb
*                                          &n
*  L_DATETO = '99991231'.                                   
*  L_NATION = '8'.                                    &
*                                          &n
*  SORT IT_KNA1 BY KUNNR.                                  &
*  LOOP AT IT_KNA1.                                    
*    CLEAR LS_KADRC.                                   
*    SELECT SINGLE * INTO LS_KADRC                              &
*      FROM ADRC                                  
*      WHERE ADDRNUMBER EQ IT_KNA1-ADRNR                            &n
*        AND DATE_TO    EQ L_DATETO.                         
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      CONCATENATE LS_KADRC-CITY1 LS_KADRC-STREET                           &nbs
*       LS_KADRC-HOUSE_NUM1 INTO IT_KNA1-KU_ADDR SEPARATED BY SPACE.                     &
*      MODIFY IT_KNA1 TRANSPORTING KU_ADDR.                            
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
**                                          &
*    CLEAR : LT_KNVK, LT_KNVK[].                               &n
*    SELECT NAME1 NAMEV PRSNR  KUNNR                             
*      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_KNVK                         &
*      FROM KNVK                                  
*     WHERE KUNNR = IT_KNA1-KUNNR.                              &
*    SORT LT_KNVK BY KUNNR.                                &
*    IF LT_KNVK[] IS NOT INITIAL.                              &n
*      LOOP AT  LT_KNVK WHERE KUNNR = IT_KNA1-KUNNR.                       
*        CLEAR LV_SMTP_ADDR.                              &n
*        CONCATENATE LT_KNVK-NAMEV LT_KNVK-NAME1                          &
*           INTO IT_KNA1-IP_PERSNAME1.                          &
*        SELECT SINGLE SMTP_ADDR INTO LV_SMTP_ADDR                        &
*          FROM ADR6                              
*          WHERE  PERSNUMBER EQ LT_KNVK-PRSNR                       &n
*          AND SMTP_ADDR NE SPACE.                          
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          IT_KNA1-IP_EMAIL1 = LV_SMTP_ADDR .                        &
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*        MODIFY IT_KNA1 .                              
*        IF IT_KNA1-IP_PERSNAME1 IS NOT INITIAL AND                       &
*            IT_KNA1-IP_EMAIL1 IS NOT INITIAL.                      &n
*          EXIT.                               &nb
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDLOOP.                                   
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
**                                          &
*    SELECT SINGLE A~KUNN2                                 &
*      INTO IT_KNA1-KUNN2                                &nb
*      FROM KNVP AS A INNER JOIN KNA1 AS B                        
*      ON A~KUNNR EQ B~KUNNR                              &n
*      WHERE A~KUNNR EQ IT_KNA1-KUNNR                             
*      AND A~PARVW EQ 'Z4'.                              &nb
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      MODIFY IT_KNA1 TRANSPORTING KUNN2.                            &
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
**                                          &
*  SORT IT_KNA1 BY BUKRS KUNNR.                                &n
**                                          &
*ENDFORM.                    " SELECT_KNA1                  
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
**& Form select_company                                     
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*FORM SELECT_COMPANY.                                      &
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LT_BUPLA TYPE J_1BBRANCH OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                       &
*         LT_ADRC  TYPE ADRC OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                   &
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : IT_COMP, IT_COMP[].                                 &n
*  IF IT_BSET[] IS NOT INITIAL.                                &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_BSET[] TO IT_COMP[].                             
**                                          &
*    SORT IT_COMP BY BUKRS BUPLA.                              &n
*    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM IT_COMP COMPARING BUKRS BUPLA.                      &
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
**  LOOP AT GT_VAT.                                    
**    MOVE-CORRESPONDING GT_VAT TO IT_COMP.                             &nb
**    APPEND IT_COMP.                                   
**  ENDLOOP.                                       
*  SORT IT_COMP BY BUKRS BUPLA.                                &n
*  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM IT_COMP COMPARING BUKRS BUPLA.                        &
**                                          &
*                                          &n
*** 사업장 정보                                       &
*  CLEAR : LT_BUPLA, LT_BUPLA[].                                 
*  IF IT_COMP[] IS NOT INITIAL.                                &n
*    SELECT BUKRS BRANCH ADRNR STATE_INSC NAME                           &n
*           KR_REPRES KR_BUSTYPE KR_INDTYPE "PERSON_NAME PERSON_EMAIL1                  &n
*      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_BUPLA                         
*      FROM J_1BBRANCH                                 
*      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN IT_COMP                            &nbs
*      WHERE BUKRS = IT_COMP-BUKRS                             &n
*      AND BRANCH = IT_COMP-BUPLA.                             &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*** 사업장 주소&종사업장번호                                      
*  CLEAR :  LT_ADRC, LT_ADRC[].                                &n
*  IF LT_BUPLA[] IS NOT INITIAL.                                &
*    SELECT ADDRNUMBER NAME1 CITY1 STREET HOUSE_NUM1 POST_CODE1                       &nbs
*      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_ADRC                         &
*      FROM ADRC                                  
*      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN LT_BUPLA                            &nb
*      WHERE ADDRNUMBER = LT_BUPLA-ADRNR.                            &
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  SORT IT_COMP  BY BUKRS BUPLA.                               &n
*  SORT LT_BUPLA BY BUKRS BRANCH.                                
*  SORT LT_ADRC  BY ADDRNUMBER.                                &n
*                                          &n
*  LOOP AT IT_COMP.                                    
*    READ TABLE LT_BUPLA WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_COMP-BUKRS                        &
*                                 BRANCH = IT_COMP-BUPLA    
*                                 BINARY SEARCH.      &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      "사업자번호 특수문자 제거                                &n
*      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[^[:digit:]]'                        &n
*      IN LT_BUPLA-STATE_INSC WITH ''.                            &nbs
*      CONDENSE LT_BUPLA-STATE_INSC.                              &nbs
*                                          &n
*      IT_COMP-SU_ID      = LT_BUPLA-STATE_INSC.                       &nbs
**      it_comp-su_name    = lt_bupla-name.                          &
*      IT_COMP-SU_REPRES  = LT_BUPLA-KR_REPRES.                           &
*      IT_COMP-SU_INDTYPE = LT_BUPLA-KR_BUSTYPE. "업종                          &n
*      IT_COMP-SU_BUSTYPE = LT_BUPLA-KR_INDTYPE. "업태                          &n
**      IT_COMP-SU_PERSNAME = LT_BUPLA-PERSON_NAME.                           &n
**      IT_COMP-SU_EMAIL = LT_BUPLA-PERSON_EMAIL1.                           &nb
*                                          &n
*      READ TABLE LT_ADRC WITH KEY ADDRNUMBER = LT_BUPLA-ADRNR                     &n
*                                  BINARY SEARCH.     &
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                               
*        CONDENSE : LT_ADRC-CITY1, LT_ADRC-CITY2,                         &
*        LT_ADRC-STREET, LT_ADRC-HOUSE_NUM1.                           &nbs
*                                          &n
*        CONCATENATE LT_ADRC-CITY1                             &n
*        LT_ADRC-STREET LT_ADRC-HOUSE_NUM1                            
*        INTO IT_COMP-SU_ADDR SEPARATED BY SPACE.                        &n
*        IT_COMP-SU_NAME    = LT_ADRC-NAME1.                        &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    MODIFY IT_COMP. CLEAR IT_COMP.                               
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*  SORT IT_COMP BY BUKRS BUPLA.                                &n
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.                                         
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
**&      Form  MODIFY_DATA                               &nb
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*FORM MODIFY_DATA .                                     &nbs
**                                          &
*  DATA : LT_HEAD LIKE IT_HEAD.                                &n
*  DATA : LV_CNT TYPE N LENGTH 5.                              &n
*  DATA : LV_TABIX LIKE SY-TABIX.                                
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR: IT_HEAD, IT_HEAD[],                                  &n
*         IT_ITEM, IT_ITEM[],                             &n
*         IT_GOOD, IT_GOOD[].                             &n
**                                          &
*  LOOP AT IT_BSET.                                    
*                                          &n
*    CLEAR : IT_HEAD, IT_ITEM.                               &nbs
*                                          &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_BSET TO IT_HEAD.                             &nb
**    IT_HEAD-DMBTR = IT_HEAD-HWBAS + IT_HEAD-HWSTE.                           &
*                                          &n
** 금액                                         
*    IF IT_HEAD-CHARGETOTAL IS INITIAL                              &n
*      AND IT_HEAD-TAXTOTAL IS INITIAL.                            &nb
*      IT_HEAD-CHARGETOTAL = IT_BSET-HWBAS.                            &nbs
*      IT_HEAD-TAXTOTAL = IT_BSET-HWSTE.                             &
*      IT_HEAD-GRANDTOTAL = IT_HEAD-CHARGETOTAL + IT_HEAD-TAXTOTAL.                       
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
** 작성일자                                        &nb
*    READ TABLE S_IDATE INDEX 1.                              &nb
*    IT_HEAD-ISSUE_DATE = S_IDATE-LOW.                               &
*** 세금코드                                        &n
*    IF IT_HEAD-MWSKZ IS INITIAL.                               &
*      IT_HEAD-MWSKZ = IT_BSET-MWSKZ.                             &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
***     세금계산서종류 일반/영세율 구분.                                &n
*    IF IT_HEAD-TYPE_CODE IS INITIAL.                              &nb
*      IF IT_HEAD-MWSKZ IS NOT INITIAL.                           &nbs
*        IF IT_HEAD-TAXTOTAL NE 0.                           &nbs
*          IT_HEAD-TYPE_CODE = '0101'."일반                         &nbs
*        ELSE.                                 &nb
*          CLEAR : IT_MWSKZ.                            
*          READ TABLE IT_MWSKZ WITH KEY MWSKZ = IT_BSET-MWSKZ.                  
*          IF IT_MWSKZ-KBETR > 0 .                        &nbs
*            IT_HEAD-TYPE_CODE = '0101'."일반                       &nbs
*          ELSEIF IT_MWSKZ-MWSKZ = 'D1'.                         
*            IT_HEAD-TYPE_CODE = '0301'."면세                       &nbs
*          ELSE.                               &nb
*            IT_HEAD-TYPE_CODE = '0102'.                        &
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    READ TABLE IT_KNA1 WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_HEAD-BUKRS                        &n
*                                KUNNR = IT_HEAD-KUNNR     &
*                                BINARY SEARCH.       &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      IT_HEAD-IP_ID = IT_KNA1-STCD2.                             &nbs
*      IT_HEAD-IP_NAME = IT_KNA1-NAME1.                             &n
*      IT_HEAD-IP_REPRES = IT_KNA1-J_1KFREPRE.                            &
*      IT_HEAD-IP_ADDR = IT_KNA1-KU_ADDR.                             
*      IT_HEAD-IP_BUSTYPE = IT_KNA1-J_1KFTBUS.                            &
*      IT_HEAD-IP_INDTYPE = IT_KNA1-J_1KFTIND.                            &
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '-' IN IT_HEAD-IP_ID WITH ''.                      &n
*    CONDENSE IT_HEAD-IP_ID.                                 &nbs
*                                          &n
**   사업자번호 : 10자리, 개인주민번호 : 13자리                              &nb
**   외국인 : 9999999999999(고정) 및 비고에 여권번호 및 외국인등록번호기재                         &nbs
*    IF IT_HEAD-IP_TYPECODE IS NOT INITIAL.                            &nbs
*      CASE IT_HEAD-IP_TYPECODE.                               &n
*        WHEN '01'. "사업자등록번호                             &nb
*        WHEN '02'. "주민등록번호                             &nbs
*        WHEN '03'. "외국인등록번호                             &nb
*          IT_HEAD-DESC_TEXT2 = IT_HEAD-IP_ID.                         
*          IT_HEAD-IP_ID = '9999999999999'.                         &n
*      ENDCASE.                                   
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      CASE STRLEN( IT_HEAD-IP_ID ).                             
*        WHEN 10.                                &
*          IT_HEAD-IP_TYPECODE = '01'. "사업자등록번호                        
*        WHEN 13.                                &
*          IT_HEAD-IP_TYPECODE = '02'. "주민등록번호                        
*      ENDCASE.                                   
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    "고객 기준 사업장이 지정되어 있지 않은 경우 전표 사업장 사용                         
**    CLEAR GT_VAT.                                   &
**    READ TABLE GT_VAT WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_BSET-BUKRS                        &n
**                               KUNNR = IT_BSET-KUNNR      
**                               BINARY SEARCH.        
**    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
**      IT_HEAD-BUPLA = GT_VAT-BUPLA.                             &nbs
**    ENDIF.                                     &
*                                          &n
*    IF IT_HEAD-BUPLA IS INITIAL.                               &
*      IT_HEAD-BUPLA = IT_HEAD-DOC_BUPLA.                             
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    "공급받는자 담당자정보                                   &nb
**    CLEAR : LV_TABIX.                                 &nbs
**    LOOP AT IT_VAT WHERE BUKRS EQ IT_HEAD-BUKRS                          
**                     AND KUNNR EQ IT_HEAD-KUNNR.              &
**      IF IT_HEAD-IP_EMAIL1 IS INITIAL.                            &n
**        IT_HEAD-IP_EMAIL1 = IT_VAT-IP_EMAIL1.                          &n
**        IT_HEAD-IP_HPNO1 = IT_VAT-IP_HPNO1.                          &nbs
**        IT_HEAD-IP_TELNO1 = IT_VAT-IP_TELNO1.                          &n
**        IT_HEAD-IP_PERSNAME1 = IT_VAT-IP_PERSNAME1.                         &n
**      ELSE.                                   &n
**        IT_HEAD-IP_EMAIL2 = IT_VAT-IP_EMAIL1.                          &n
**        IT_HEAD-IP_HPNO2 = IT_VAT-IP_HPNO1.                          &nbs
**        IT_HEAD-IP_TELNO2 = IT_VAT-IP_TELNO1.                          &n
**        IT_HEAD-IP_PERSNAME2 = IT_VAT-IP_PERSNAME1.                         &n
**      ENDIF.                                   &
**    ENDLOOP.                                     
*                                          &n
*    CLEAR IT_COMP.                                   &
*    READ TABLE IT_COMP WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_HEAD-BUKRS                        &n
*                                BUPLA = IT_HEAD-BUPLA     &
*                                BINARY SEARCH.       &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      IT_HEAD-BUPLA = IT_COMP-BUPLA.           "사업장                  
*      IT_HEAD-SU_ID = IT_COMP-SU_ID.           "사업자번호                 &nbs
*      IT_HEAD-SU_MIN = IT_COMP-SU_MIN.         "종사업자번호                   &
*      IT_HEAD-SU_NAME = IT_COMP-SU_NAME.       "사업장명                     &
*      IT_HEAD-SU_REPRES = IT_COMP-SU_REPRES.   "대표자명                        &nb
*      IT_HEAD-SU_ADDR = IT_COMP-SU_ADDR.       "주소                     &nb
*      IT_HEAD-SU_BUSTYPE = IT_COMP-SU_BUSTYPE. "업태                          &nb
*      IT_HEAD-SU_INDTYPE = IT_COMP-SU_INDTYPE. "업종                          &nb
*      IT_HEAD-SU_PERSNAME = IT_COMP-SU_PERSNAME.                           &nbs
*      IT_HEAD-SU_EMAIL = IT_COMP-SU_EMAIL.                            &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    READ TABLE IT_300 WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_HEAD-BUKRS                        &nb
*                               BELNR = IT_HEAD-BELNR      &
*                               GJAHR = IT_HEAD-GJAHR      &
*                               BINARY SEARCH.        &
*    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                 
*      IT_HEAD-EXPCD = IT_300-EXPCD.                              
*      IT_HEAD-EXP_BIGO = IT_300-EXP_BIGO.                             
*      IT_HEAD-EXP_DATE = IT_300-ISSUE_DATE.                            &nb
*      IT_HEAD-EXP_ISSUE_ID = IT_300-ISSUE_ID.                            &
*                                          &n
*      SELECT SINGLE DDTEXT INTO IT_HEAD-EXPCD_TXT                          
*        FROM DD07T                                
*       WHERE DOMNAME    EQ 'ZDTV3D_EXPCD'                        &nbs
*         AND DDLANGUAGE EQ SY-LANGU                          &nb
*         AND DOMVALUE_L EQ IT_HEAD-EXPCD.                         &nb
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING : IT_HEAD TO IT_ITEM.                            &n
*                                          &n
** 전표별 순번부여                                       
*    ADD 1 TO LV_CNT.                                 &
*    IT_ITEM-INDEX = LV_CNT.                                 
*                                          &n
** 합산 key 확인                                      
*    IF IT_HEAD-COMBINED_ID NE SPACE.                              &nb
*      IT_HEAD-BELNR = 'MULTI'.                              &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    IF IT_HEAD-PURP_CODE IS INITIAL.                              &nb
*      IT_HEAD-PURP_CODE = '02'.                              &nb
*      IT_HEAD-PURP_TXT = '청구'.                              &nbs
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
** 상세정보(전표)                                        
*    IF IT_HEAD-DESC_TEXT1 IS INITIAL.                              &n
*      IT_HEAD-DESC_TEXT1 = IT_BSET-BKTXT.                             
*      IT_ITEM-DESC_TEXT1 = IT_BSET-BKTXT.                             
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      IT_ITEM-DESC_TEXT1 = IT_HEAD-DESC_TEXT1.                            
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
**                                          &
*    IT_ITEM-BUDAT = IT_BSET-BUDAT.                               &nbs
*    IT_ITEM-BLDAT = IT_BSET-BLDAT.                               &nbs
*    IT_ITEM-BLART = IT_BSET-BLART.                               &nbs
*                                          &n
*    APPEND IT_HEAD. CLEAR IT_HEAD.                               
*    APPEND IT_ITEM. CLEAR IT_ITEM.                               
*                                          &n
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*** 상세정보(품목)                                       &nbs
*  LOOP AT IT_ITEM.                                    
*                                          &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_ITEM TO IT_GOOD.                             &nb
*                                          &n
*    IT_GOOD-GOOD_SEQ = 1.                                 &
*    IT_GOOD-GOOD_DATE = IT_ITEM-ISSUE_DATE.                              &
*    IT_GOOD-GOOD_NAME = 'PVD Coating'.                              &
*                                          &n
*                                          &n
*    IT_GOOD-GOOD_INVAMOUNT = IT_ITEM-CHARGETOTAL.                             &
*    IT_GOOD-GOOD_TAXAMOUNT = IT_ITEM-TAXTOTAL.                             &nbs
*                                          &n
*    APPEND IT_GOOD. CLEAR IT_GOOD.                               
*                                          &n
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*  SORT IT_HEAD BY COMBINED_ID DESCENDING                              &nbs
*          BUKRS ASCENDING BELNR ASCENDING GJAHR ASCENDING.                    &
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.                    " MODIFY_DATA                  
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
**& FORM CHECK_INVOICE_STAT                                    &n
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*FORM CHECK_INVOICE_STAT.                                     &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LT_ITEM LIKE IT_ITEM OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                        
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : LT_ITEM, LT_ITEM[].                                 &n
*                                          &n
** 국세청상태조회 데이터 생성                                     &
*  IF IT_HEAD[] IS NOT INITIAL.                                &n
*                                          &n
*    "> 2021.12.30 세금계산서 발행프로그램 속도개선                             &n
*    LT_ITEM[] = IT_ITEM[].                                 
*                                          &n
*    SORT LT_ITEM BY COMBINED_ID.                               &
*    SORT IT_ITEM BY BUKRS BELNR GJAHR.                            &nb
*    "> 2021.12.30 세금계산서 발행프로그램 속도개선                             &n
*                                          &n
*** 계속 동일한 PERFORM 절을 사용하기 때문에 INV_SEQ 있는 내역 제외                          &n
*    LOOP AT IT_HEAD WHERE INV_SEQ EQ SPACE.                           
*      " 라인번호 부여                                 &
*      IF IT_HEAD-COMBINED_ID IS NOT INITIAL.                          &nbs
*        "> 2021.12.30 세금계산서 발행프로그램 속도개선                         &n
*        READ TABLE LT_ITEM WITH KEY COMBINED_ID = IT_HEAD-COMBINED_ID                  &n
*                                    BINARY SEARCH.   &
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          IT_HEAD-INDEX = LT_ITEM-INDEX.                         &nbs
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*        "> 2021.12.30 세금계산서 발행프로그램 속도개선                         &n
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
*        READ TABLE IT_ITEM WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_HEAD-BUKRS                    &n
*                                    BELNR = IT_HEAD-BELNR &
*                                    GJAHR = IT_HEAD-GJAHR &
*                                    BINARY SEARCH.   &
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          IT_HEAD-INDEX = IT_ITEM-INDEX.                         &nbs
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*** 필수적 기재사항 점검                                     &nb
**     세금계산서정보(작성일자, 공급가액, 세액, 합계액)                              
*      IF IT_HEAD-ISSUE_DATE IS INITIAL                            &nb
*        OR IT_HEAD-CHARGETOTAL IS INITIAL                          &n
*        OR IT_HEAD-GRANDTOTAL IS INITIAL.                          &n
*        IT_HEAD-STATS = ICON_RED_LIGHT.                           &nb
*        IT_HEAD-MESSAGE = '세금계산서 필수사항 누락'.                         &n
*        MODIFY IT_HEAD.                               
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
**    공급자 사업자번호, 회사명, 대표자명                                &n
*      IF IT_HEAD-SU_ID IS INITIAL                             &n
*        OR IT_HEAD-SU_NAME IS INITIAL                           
*        OR IT_HEAD-SU_REPRES IS INITIAL.                          &nb
*        IT_HEAD-STATS = ICON_RED_LIGHT.                           &nb
*        IT_HEAD-MESSAGE = '공급자 필요적 기재사항 누락'.                        &
*        MODIFY IT_HEAD.                               
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
**    거래처 사업자번호, 회사명, 대표자명                                &n
*      IF IT_HEAD-IP_ID IS INITIAL                             &n
*        OR IT_HEAD-IP_NAME IS INITIAL                           
*        OR IT_HEAD-IP_REPRES IS INITIAL.                          &nb
*        IT_HEAD-STATS = ICON_RED_LIGHT.                           &nb
*        IT_HEAD-MESSAGE = '공급받는자 필요적 기재사항 누락'.                        
*        MODIFY IT_HEAD.                               
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*** 임의적 기재사항 점검                                     &nb
**     카카오공동체 주소, 업종, 업태, 담당자명, 담당자연락처, 담당자이메일                         &nbs
*      IF IT_HEAD-SU_ADDR IS INITIAL                             
*        OR IT_HEAD-SU_BUSTYPE IS INITIAL                          &nb
*        OR IT_HEAD-SU_INDTYPE IS INITIAL                          &nb
*        OR IT_HEAD-SU_PERSNAME IS INITIAL                          &n
*        OR IT_HEAD-SU_EMAIL IS INITIAL.                          &nbs
*        IT_HEAD-STATS = ICON_YELLOW_LIGHT.                           
*        IT_HEAD-MESSAGE = '공급자 임의 기재사항 누락'.                        &n
*        MODIFY IT_HEAD.                               
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
**     거래처 주소, 업종, 업태, 담당자명, 담당자연락처, 담당자이메일                          &
*      IF IT_HEAD-IP_ADDR IS INITIAL                             
*        OR IT_HEAD-IP_BUSTYPE IS INITIAL                          &nb
*        OR IT_HEAD-IP_INDTYPE IS INITIAL                          &nb
*        OR IT_HEAD-IP_PERSNAME1 IS INITIAL                          &
*        OR IT_HEAD-IP_EMAIL1 IS INITIAL.                          &nb
*        IT_HEAD-STATS = ICON_YELLOW_LIGHT.                           
*        IT_HEAD-MESSAGE = '공급받는자 임의 기재사항 누락'.                        
*        MODIFY IT_HEAD.                               
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*      IT_HEAD-STATS = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.                             &
*      IT_HEAD-MESSAGE = ''.                               &
*      MODIFY IT_HEAD.                                 
*                                          &n
*    ENDLOOP.                                     
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.  "CHECK_INVOICE_STAT                                    
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n

**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*MODULE PBO_0100 OUTPUT.                                     
*                                          &n
*  DATA L_SIZE TYPE I.                                  &nbs
*  L_SIZE = SY-SCOLS * '100'.                                &nbs
*                                          &n
*  IF G_DOCKING_CONTAINER IS INITIAL.                                &
** CONTAINER 생성                                      &n
*    PERFORM CREATE_CUST_CONT.                                 &n
** LAYOUT 설정                                       
*    PERFORM BUILD_LAYOUT.                                  
** TOOLBAR 설정                                      &nbs
*    PERFORM SET_TOOLBAR.                                  &
** FIELDCATALOG 설정                                      
*    PERFORM BUILD_FIELDCATALOG.                                 
** EVENT 설정                                       
*    PERFORM SET_GRID_EVENTS USING G_ALV_GRID ''.                           &nbs
**___data MODIFY event                                     &

*      EXPORTING                                   
*        I_EVENT_ID = CL_GUI_ALV_GRID=>MC_EVT_MODIFIED.                        &nb
** ALV 설정                                       &n
*    PERFORM FIRST_DISPLAY.                                  
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
** 새로고침                                        &nb
*    CALL METHOD G_ALV_GRID->REFRESH_TABLE_DISPLAY.                            &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*ENDMODULE.                                        &nbs

**& Form CREATE_CUST_CONT                                    &nbs

**& Form BUILD_FIELDCATALOG                                    &n
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*FORM BUILD_FIELDCATALOG .                                    &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA: LT_SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV   TYPE SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV.                           
*  DATA: LV_TABIX TYPE SY-TABIX,                                 
*        LS_FDCAT LIKE LVC_S_FCAT.                            &nb
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR: GT_FDCAT, GT_FDCAT[].                                  
*                                          &n
**> FIELD발췌                                       &n
*  CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'                               &n
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      I_PROGRAM_NAME         = SY-REPID                      &nb
*      I_INTERNAL_TABNAME     = 'IT_HEAD'                         &nbs
*      I_STRUCTURE_NAME       = ''                         &
*      I_CLIENT_NEVER_DISPLAY = 'X'                              
*      I_INCLNAME             = SY-REPID                   &
*      I_BYPASSING_BUFFER     = 'X'                          &nbs
*    CHANGING                                     
*      CT_FIELDCAT            = LT_SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV[]                 &n
*    EXCEPTIONS                                    &nbs
*      INCONSISTENT_INTERFACE = 1                              &n
*      PROGRAM_ERROR          = 2                       
*      OTHERS                 = 3.                 
*                                          &n
*  CALL FUNCTION 'LVC_TRANSFER_FROM_SLIS'                                &n
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      IT_FIELDCAT_ALV = LT_SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV[]                           &nbs
*    IMPORTING                                     
*      ET_FIELDCAT_LVC = GT_FDCAT[]                              
*    TABLES                                     &n
*      IT_DATA         = IT_HEAD[]                       &nb
*    EXCEPTIONS                                    &nbs
*      IT_DATA_MISSING = 1                               &nb
*      OTHERS          = 2.                        
*                                          &n
*  LOOP AT GT_FDCAT INTO LS_FDCAT.                                
*    LV_TABIX = SY-TABIX.                                 &n
*    CASE LS_FDCAT-FIELDNAME.                                 &nb
*      WHEN 'STATS'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*      WHEN 'MESSAGE'.                                 
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*      WHEN 'PURP_TXT'.                                 
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        SET_TEXT '영수/청구'.                              &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-COL_POS = '16'.                            &nbs
*      WHEN 'COMBINED_ID'.                                &n
*      WHEN 'ISSUE_DATE'.                                &nb
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C400'.                            
*      WHEN 'EXP_BIGO'.                                 
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = ' '.                            &
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C700'.                            
*        SET_TEXT '발행제외비고'.                              &nb
*      WHEN 'EXPCD_TXT'.                                &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C700'.                            
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = ' '.                            &
*        SET_TEXT '발행제외사유'.                              &nb
*      WHEN 'EXP_ISSUE_ID'.                                &
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C700'.                            
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = ' '.                            &
*      WHEN 'EXP_DATE'.                                 
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C700'.                            
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = ' '.                            &
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        SET_TEXT '발행제외일자'.                              &nb
*      WHEN 'BUDAT' OR 'BLDAT'.                              
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*      WHEN 'BUKRS'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        SET_TEXT 'Cocd'.                               
*      WHEN 'DOC_BUPLA'.                                &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        SET_TEXT 'Bus. Pl.'.                             &n
*      WHEN 'ISSUE_DATE'.                                &nb
*        SET_TEXT '작성일자'.                               
*      WHEN 'BELNR'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        SET_TEXT '전표번호'.                               
*      WHEN 'GJAHR'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        SET_TEXT '회계연도'.                               
*      WHEN 'KUNNR'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        SET_TEXT 'Customer'.                              &
*      WHEN 'IP_ID'.                                 &n
*        SET_TEXT '사업자번호'.                              &nbs
*      WHEN 'IP_NAME'.                                 
*        SET_TEXT '거래처명'.                               
*      WHEN 'CHARGETOTAL'.                                &n
*        LS_FDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            &n
*        SET_TEXT '공급가액'.                               
*      WHEN 'TAXTOTAL'.                                 
*        LS_FDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            &n
*        SET_TEXT '세액'.                               &
*      WHEN 'GRANDTOTAL'.                                &nb
*        LS_FDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            &n
*        SET_TEXT '총금액'.                               
*      WHEN 'INV_SEQ'.                                 
*        SET_TEXT '세금계산서증빙번호'.                              
*      WHEN 'MESSAGE'.                                 
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C700'.                            
*        SET_TEXT 'Message'.                              &n
*      WHEN 'MWSKZ' OR 'BLART'.                              
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*      WHEN 'IP_BUSTYPE'.                                &nb
*        SET_TEXT '공급받는자 업태'.                             &n
*      WHEN 'IP_INDTYPE'.                                &nb
*        SET_TEXT '공급받는자 종목(업종)'.                            &nbs
*      WHEN 'SU_BUSTYPE'.                                &nb
*        SET_TEXT '공급자 업태'.                             &nbs
*      WHEN 'SU_INDTYPE'.                                &nb
*        SET_TEXT '공급자 종목(업종)'.                             
*      WHEN 'BUPLA'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C400'.                            
*        SET_TEXT 'Vat Bus. Pl.'.                            
*      WHEN 'KUNNR'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*      WHEN 'KUNN2'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*        LS_FDCAT-KEY = ' '.                            &nbs
*        SET_TEXT 'Internal Sales Cont.'.                          &nb
*      WHEN 'DMBTR'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            &n
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*      WHEN 'HWBAS'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            &n
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*      WHEN 'HWSTE'.                                 &n
*        LS_FDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            &n
*        LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'.                            
*      WHEN 'WAERS' OR 'INTER_NO' OR 'INV_SIGN'                         &nb
*        OR 'ASP_CODE' OR 'AMEND_CODE' OR 'ISSUE_ID_OLD'                      &n
*        OR 'DESC_TEXT2' OR 'DESC_TEXT3' OR 'IP_DEPTNAME1'                      
*        OR 'IP_DEPTNAME2' OR 'SU_DEPTNAME' OR 'INDEX'                      &nbs
*        OR 'COMBINED_ID' OR 'EXPCD' OR 'CHKBOX'                       &nbs
*        OR 'IP_TYPECODE' OR 'TYPE_CODE' OR 'COMBINED_ID'.                      
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = 'X'.                             
*      WHEN OTHERS.                                 &nb
**        ls_fdcat-no_out = 'X'.                             
*    ENDCASE.                                     
*                                          &n
*    IF LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE IS INITIAL.                              &n
*      LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C400'.                              
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    IF P_CRD EQ 'X'.                                 &
*      IF LS_FDCAT-FIELDNAME CP 'EXP*'.                            &nb
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = 'X'.                             
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    IF P_DEL EQ 'X'.                                 &
*      IF LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C300'                             
*        OR LS_FDCAT-EMPHASIZE = 'C700'.                          &nbs
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
*        LS_FDCAT-NO_OUT = 'X'.                             
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    LS_FDCAT-COL_OPT = 'X'.                                 
*    MODIFY GT_FDCAT FROM LS_FDCAT INDEX LV_TABIX.                          &nbs
*    CLEAR: LS_FDCAT,                                   
*           LV_TABIX.                              
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*ENDFORM.

**&      Form  SEND_DATA                                
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*FORM SEND_DATA USING P_TEST                                   &n
*                     P_RESERVE                    
*                     P_CLOSE.                    
**                                          &
*  DATA : LV_CNT     TYPE I, MAT_CNT(6),                          &nbs
*         LV_INV_SEQ LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_HD-INV_SEQ,                         &nb
*         LV_NAME    LIKE ZDTV3T_AR_ITEM-GOOD_NAME.                      &n
**                                          &
*  DATA : LT_HEAD LIKE IT_HEAD OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                        
*         LS_HEAD LIKE IT_HEAD,                            &
*         LT_ITEM LIKE IT_ITEM OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                   &nbs
*         LS_ITEM LIKE IT_ITEM,                            &
*         LT_GOOD LIKE IT_GOOD OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                   &nbs
*         LS_GOOD LIKE IT_GOOD,                            &
*         LT_TMP  LIKE IT_HEAD OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                   
**                                          &
*  DATA : IT_HD     LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_HD   OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                 &n
*         IT_IM     LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_IM   OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,             &
*         IT_PM     LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_PM   OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,             &
*         IT_EX     LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_EX   OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,             &
*         IT_EX_D   LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_EX_D OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,                &nb
*         IT_RETURN LIKE ZDTV3S_RETURN  OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.                 &n
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LS_EXT_D  LIKE ZDTV3S_AR_EX_D.                              
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_CHARGETOTAL LIKE ZDTV3T_AR_HEAD-CHARGETOTAL,                            
*         LV_TAXTOTAL    LIKE ZDTV3T_AR_HEAD-TAXTOTAL.                      
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_SEND.                                    &
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_NUMBER TYPE CHAR10.                                &
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : GT_RETURN, GT_RETURN[].                                &nbs
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : LT_TMP, LT_TMP[], LT_HEAD, LT_HEAD[],                            &nbs
*          LT_ITEM, LT_ITEM[], LT_GOOD, LT_GOOD[].                       &n
*                                          &n
*  LT_HEAD[] = IT_HEAD[].                                   
*                                          &n
*  IF P_TEST NE 'X'. "시뮬레이션                                 
*    IF P_CLOSE EQ 'X'.                                 
*      DELETE LT_HEAD WHERE CHKBOX  EQ SPACE.                         
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      DELETE LT_HEAD WHERE CHKBOX  EQ SPACE                         &
*                        OR STATS  EQ ICON_RED_LIGHT.          &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    DELETE LT_HEAD WHERE CHKBOX  EQ SPACE.                           
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*** 발행정보 및 상세 정보                                    &nb
*  LOOP AT LT_HEAD.                                    
*    IF LT_HEAD-COMBINED_ID IS INITIAL.                              &
*      SORT IT_ITEM BY BUKRS BELNR GJAHR.                          &nb
*      READ TABLE IT_ITEM WITH KEY BUKRS = LT_HEAD-BUKRS                      &n
*                                  BELNR = LT_HEAD-BELNR   &
*                                  GJAHR = LT_HEAD-GJAHR   &
*                                  BINARY SEARCH.     &
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                               
*        MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.                         &nb
*        APPEND LT_ITEM. CLEAR LT_ITEM.                           
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      SORT IT_ITEM BY COMBINED_ID.                             &
*      READ TABLE IT_ITEM WITH KEY COMBINED_ID = LT_HEAD-COMBINED_ID.                    &
*      LOOP AT IT_ITEM FROM SY-TABIX.                            
*        IF IT_ITEM-COMBINED_ID NE LT_HEAD-COMBINED_ID.                        &
*          EXIT.                               &nb
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*                                          &n
*        MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.                         &nb
*        APPEND LT_ITEM. CLEAR LT_ITEM.                           
*      ENDLOOP.                                   
*    ENDIF.                                     &n

*                                          &n
*        IF IT_GOOD-GOOD_DATE+0(6) NE IT_HEAD-ISSUE_DATE+0(6).

*          GV_RESULT = 'X'.                            
*          EXIT.                               &nb
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*      ENDLOOP.                                   
*                                          &n

*        GV_RESULT = ''.                              &
*        "발행할 수 없는 내역이 포함되어 있는 경우 발행되는 건만 처리하기 위해                   &n
*        CLEAR IT_HEAD-CHKBOX.                              
*        MODIFY IT_HEAD TRANSPORTING CHKBOX.                          
*        CONTINUE.                                 
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n

** 발행경고(임의적 기재사항 누락)_자동발행인 경우 미점검

*FORM EVENT_DOUBLE_CLICK  USING  PS_LVC_S_ROW TYPE LVC_S_ROW                          &nbs

*    WHEN 'BELNR'.                                   &n
*      CASE SY-DYNNR.                                 &

*          READ TABLE IT_HEAD INDEX PS_ROW_NO-ROW_ID.                      
*          IF IT_HEAD-BELNR NE 'MULTI'.                         &
*            SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD IT_HEAD-BUKRS.                   
*            SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD IT_HEAD-BELNR.

*                                          &n

*          ELSEIF IT_HEAD-BELNR EQ 'MULTI'.                        &nb
*            CLEAR : IT_DOC, IT_DOC[].                       &nbs

*                                          BI
*              LOOP AT IT_ITEM FROM SY-TABIX.

*                  EXIT.                       &nb

*                APPEND IT_DOC. CLEAR IT_DOC.                   &
*              ENDLOOP.                           
*            ELSE.                             &nb
*              SORT IT_ITEM BY BUKRS BELNR GJAHR.                  &nb
*              READ TABLE IT_ITEM WITH KEY BUKRS = IT_HEAD-BUKRS              &n
*                                          BE
*                                          GJ
*                                          BI
*              IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                       
*                MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_ITEM TO IT_DOC.                 &nbs
*                IT_DOC-BUPLA = IT_ITEM-DOC_BUPLA.                   &
*                APPEND IT_DOC. CLEAR IT_DOC.                   &
*              ENDIF.                           &n
*            ENDIF.                             &n
*            CALL SCREEN 110 STARTING AT 20 10 ENDING AT 130 20.             &nb
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        WHEN '0110'.                               &nb
*          READ TABLE IT_DOC INDEX PS_ROW_NO-ROW_ID.                      &
*          IF IT_DOC-BELNR NE 'MULTI'.                         &n
*            SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD IT_DOC-BUKRS.                   &
*            SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD IT_DOC-BELNR.                   &
*            SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD IT_DOC-GJAHR.                   &
*                                          &n
*            CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.                 &nbs
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*      ENDCASE.                                   
*                                          &n
**    WHEN .                                    &n
*    WHEN OTHERS.                                   &nb
*  ENDCASE.                                       
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.                                         
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
**& Form EVENT_DATA_CHANGED                                    &n
**&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &n
*FORM EVENT_DATA_CHANGED                                     &nbs
*        USING P_ER_DATA_CHANGED TYPE REF TO CL_ALV_CHANGED_DATA_PROTOCOL                   &nb
*              P_ONF4                           &n
*              P_ONF4_BEFORE                          &
*              P_ONF4_AFTER                          &n
*              P_UCOMM                           &
*              P_CHECK.                           
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LS_CELLS  TYPE LVC_S_MODI,                              &nbs
*         LS_ROW_ID LIKE LS_CELLS-ROW_ID,                          &nb
*         LV_CHECK  TYPE C LENGTH 200.                        &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_FNAME TYPE LVC_FNAME.                                
*                                          &n
*  DATA: LV_TAXTOTAL LIKE IS_POPUP-TAXTOTAL,                               
*        LV_INVTOTAL LIKE IS_POPUP-TAXTOTAL.                           
*                                          &n
*  CHECK P_CHECK EQ 'X'.                                  &n
*  CLEAR : LV_CHECK.                                    
*                                          &n
*  LOOP AT P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->MT_GOOD_CELLS INTO LS_CELLS.                           &n
*    CLEAR : LV_FNAME, LV_TAXTOTAL, LV_INVTOTAL.                            
*                                          &n
*    CASE LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME.                                 &nb
*      WHEN 'CHKBOX'.                                 &
**                                          &
*      WHEN 'GOOD_TAXAMOUNT'.                                
*        CALL METHOD P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->GET_CELL_VALUE                        &nbs
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_ROW_ID    = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID                     &n
*            I_FIELDNAME = LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME                       &n
*          IMPORTING                               
*            E_VALUE     = LV_TAXTOTAL.                     
*                                          &n
*        CALL METHOD P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->MODIFY_CELL                         &
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_ROW_ID    = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID                     &n
*            I_FIELDNAME = LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME                       &n
*            I_VALUE     = LV_TAXTOTAL.                     
*                                          &n
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          SY-INDEX = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID.                          &
*          IT_INV_GOOD-GOOD_TAXAMOUNT = LV_TAXTOTAL.                        
*          MODIFY IT_INV_GOOD INDEX SY-INDEX FROM IT_INV_GOOD                    
*           TRANSPORTING GOOD_TAXAMOUNT.                          
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*                                          &n
*        CLEAR IS_POPUP-TAXTOTAL.                             &nb
*                                          &n
*        DATA(LV_CNT_ROW) = LINES( IT_INV_GOOD[] ).                        
*        DO LV_CNT_ROW TIMES.                             &n
*          READ TABLE IT_INV_GOOD INDEX SY-INDEX.                      &nbs
*          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                           
*            LV_TAXTOTAL = IT_INV_GOOD-GOOD_TAXAMOUNT.                      
*            ADD LV_TAXTOTAL TO IS_POPUP-TAXTOTAL.                     &nbs
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        ENDDO.                                 &n
*        IS_POPUP-GRANDTOTAL = IS_POPUP-TAXTOTAL + IS_POPUP-CHARGETOTAL.                    &nb
*                                          &n
*      WHEN 'GOOD_INVAMOUNT'.                                
*        CALL METHOD P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->GET_CELL_VALUE                        &nbs
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_ROW_ID    = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID                     &n
*            I_FIELDNAME = LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME                       &n
*          IMPORTING                               
*            E_VALUE     = LV_INVTOTAL.                     
*                                          &n
*        CALL METHOD P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->MODIFY_CELL                         &
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_ROW_ID    = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID                     &n
*            I_FIELDNAME = LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME                       &n
*            I_VALUE     = LV_INVTOTAL.                     
*                                          &n
*        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                             
*          SY-INDEX = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID.                          &
*          IT_INV_GOOD-GOOD_INVAMOUNT = LV_INVTOTAL.                        
*          MODIFY IT_INV_GOOD INDEX SY-INDEX FROM IT_INV_GOOD                    
*           TRANSPORTING GOOD_INVAMOUNT.                          
*        ENDIF.                                 &n
*                                          &n
*        CLEAR IS_POPUP-CHARGETOTAL.                             
*                                          &n
*        LV_CNT_ROW = LINES( IT_INV_GOOD[] ).                         
*        DO LV_CNT_ROW TIMES.                             &n
*          READ TABLE IT_INV_GOOD INDEX SY-INDEX.                      &nbs
*          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                           
*            LV_INVTOTAL = IT_INV_GOOD-GOOD_INVAMOUNT.                      
*            ADD LV_INVTOTAL TO IS_POPUP-CHARGETOTAL.                     &
*          ENDIF.                               &n
*        ENDDO.                                 &n
*        IS_POPUP-GRANDTOTAL = IS_POPUP-TAXTOTAL + IS_POPUP-CHARGETOTAL.                    &nb
*                                          &n
*      WHEN OTHERS.                                 &nb
*        CALL METHOD P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->GET_CELL_VALUE                        &nbs
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_ROW_ID    = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID                     &n
*            I_FIELDNAME = LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME                       &n
*          IMPORTING                               
*            E_VALUE     = LV_CHECK.                     &nb
*                                          &n
*        CALL METHOD P_ER_DATA_CHANGED->MODIFY_CELL                         &
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_ROW_ID    = LS_CELLS-ROW_ID                     &n
*            I_FIELDNAME = LS_CELLS-FIELDNAME                       &n
*            I_VALUE     = LV_CHECK.                     &nb
*    ENDCASE.                                     
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*  CALL METHOD G_ALV_GRID->REFRESH_TABLE_DISPLAY.                              &nb
*                                          &n
*  CALL METHOD CL_GUI_CFW=>SET_NEW_OK_CODE                               &nbs
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      NEW_CODE = 'ENTER'.                               &nb
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.

*                                          &n
*  DATA : LS_FIELDCAT TYPE LVC_S_FCAT.                               &
*  DATA : LT_FIELDCAT TYPE SLIS_T_FIELDCAT_ALV,                             &nbs
*         L_FIELDCAT  TYPE SLIS_FIELDCAT_ALV.                         
*                                          &n
*  DEFINE GET_TEXT.                                     
*    ls_fieldcat-reptext    = &1.                             &nb
*    ls_fieldcat-scrtext_l  = &1.                               &
*    ls_fieldcat-scrtext_m  = &1.                               &
*    ls_fieldcat-scrtext_s  = &1.                               &

*  CALL FUNCTION 'REUSE_ALV_FIELDCATALOG_MERGE'                               &n
*    EXPORTING                                     
*      I_PROGRAM_NAME     = G_REPID_C                          &n
*      I_INTERNAL_TABNAME = 'IT_INV_GOOD'                             
*      I_BYPASSING_BUFFER = 'X'                              &nbs
*      I_INCLNAME         = G_REPID_C                       
*    CHANGING                                     
*      CT_FIELDCAT        = LT_FIELDCAT[].                       
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : GT_FIELDCAT , GT_FIELDCAT[].                               
**                                          &
*  LOOP AT LT_FIELDCAT INTO L_FIELDCAT.                               
*    CLEAR : LS_FIELDCAT.                                 &n
*    MOVE-CORRESPONDING L_FIELDCAT TO LS_FIELDCAT.                            &n
*    MOVE: L_FIELDCAT-SELTEXT_S     TO LS_FIELDCAT-SCRTEXT_S ,                      &
*          L_FIELDCAT-SELTEXT_M     TO LS_FIELDCAT-SCRTEXT_M ,                  
*          L_FIELDCAT-SELTEXT_L     TO LS_FIELDCAT-SCRTEXT_L ,                  
*          'M'                      TO LS_FIELDCAT-COLDDICTXT  ,  &nbs
*          L_FIELDCAT-REF_TABNAME   TO LS_FIELDCAT-REF_TABLE ,                   &nbs
*          L_FIELDCAT-REF_FIELDNAME TO LS_FIELDCAT-REF_FIELD.                      &n
**                                          &
*    IF LS_FIELDCAT-DATATYPE EQ 'CURR'.                              &
*      LS_FIELDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                              
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*    CASE LS_FIELDCAT-FIELDNAME.                                 
*      WHEN 'GOOD_DATE'.                                &nbs
*        LS_FIELDCAT-COL_POS = 11.                            &nb

*      WHEN 'GOOD_QUAN'.                                &nbs
*        LS_FIELDCAT-COL_POS = 15.                            &nb
*        LS_FIELDCAT-EDIT = 'X'.                             
*        GET_TEXT '물품 수량'.                              
*      WHEN 'GOOD_UNIAMOUNT'.                                
*        LS_FIELDCAT-COL_POS = 30.                            &nb
*        LS_FIELDCAT-EDIT = 'X'.                             
*        GET_TEXT '물품 단가'.                              
*      WHEN 'GOOD_INVAMOUNT'.                                
*        LS_FIELDCAT-COL_POS = 31.                            &nb
*        LS_FIELDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            
*        LS_FIELDCAT-EDIT = 'X'.                             
*        GET_TEXT '물품 공급가액'.                             &nb
*      WHEN 'GOOD_TAXAMOUNT'.                                
*        LS_FIELDCAT-COL_POS = 32.                            &nb
*        LS_FIELDCAT-CURRENCY = 'KRW'.                            
*        LS_FIELDCAT-EDIT = 'X'.                             
*        GET_TEXT '물품 세액'.                              
*      WHEN 'GOOD_DESC'.                                &nbs
*        LS_FIELDCAT-COL_POS = 40.                            &nb
*        LS_FIELDCAT-EDIT = 'X'.                             
*        GET_TEXT '비고'.                               &
*      WHEN OTHERS.                                 &nb
*        LS_FIELDCAT-NO_OUT = 'X'.                            &nb
*    ENDCASE.                                     
*                                          &n
*    INSERT LS_FIELDCAT INTO TABLE GT_FIELDCAT.                            
*                                          &n
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.                    " GET_FILEDCAT_ALV2

*FORM EVENT_UCOMM2 USING P_UCOMM TYPE SY-UCOMM                              &nbs
*                       P_CHECK.                  
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LS_LAYOUT TYPE LVC_S_LAYO.                               &nb
*                                          &n
*  CHECK P_CHECK EQ 'X'.                                  &n
*                                          &n
*  CASE P_UCOMM.                                     &n
*    WHEN 'CHG'.                                   &nbs
*      CLEAR GV_RESULT.                                 
*      PERFORM CHECK_INPUT_GOOD.                               &n
*      IF GV_RESULT EQ 'X'. "저장하면 안됨                           &n
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
*        GV_CHANGE2 = 'X'.                              
*        CALL METHOD G_GRID1->SET_READY_FOR_INPUT                         &nb
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_READY_FOR_INPUT = 1.                         
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*    WHEN 'SAVE'.                                   &nb
*      CLEAR GV_RESULT.                                 
*      PERFORM CHECK_INPUT_GOOD.                               &n
*      IF GV_RESULT EQ 'X'. "저장하면 안됨                           &n
*      ELSE.                                   &nb
*        GV_CHANGE2 = ''.                              
*        PERFORM UPDATE_GOOD.                              &
*        CALL METHOD G_GRID1->SET_READY_FOR_INPUT                         &nb
*          EXPORTING                               
*            I_READY_FOR_INPUT = 0.                         
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*                                          &n
*    WHEN 'INSR'.                                   &nb
*      CLEAR GV_RESULT.

***********************************************************************                              &nbs

*    IF LT_HEAD_NEW[] IS INITIAL.                               &

*      LV_COMBINED_ID = LS_HEAD-COMBINED_ID.                            &nb
*                                          &n
*      CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'                           &nb
*        EXPORTING                                 
*          INPUT  = LS_HEAD-INTER_NO                         &nbs
*        IMPORTING                                 
*          OUTPUT = LS_HEAD-INTER_NO.                          &n
**                                          &
**      CALL FUNCTION 'LAST_DAY_OF_MONTHS'                             
**        EXPORTING                                &nbs
**          day_in            = ls_head-issue_date               
**        IMPORTING                                &nbs
**          last_day_of_month = lv_datum                          
**        EXCEPTIONS                                &nb
**          day_in_no_date    = 1                        &nb
**          OTHERS            = 2.                 &nbs
*                                          &n
*      MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_HEAD TO LS_HEAD_NEW.                           
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*                                          &n
*    LS_HEAD_NEW-BELNR = 'MULTI'.

*                                          &n

*                                          &n
** 선택된 자료 가져오기                                     &nbs
*  CALL METHOD G_GRID1->GET_SELECTED_ROWS                                
*    IMPORTING                                     
*      ET_INDEX_ROWS = LT_ROWS.                              &nbs
*                                          &n
*  DELETE LT_ROWS WHERE INDEX = 0.                               
*                                          &n
*  CASE LINES( LT_ROWS[] ).                                  
*    WHEN 0.                                    &n
*      MESSAGE S000(ZDTV3M) DISPLAY LIKE 'W' WITH '삭제할 행을 선택하세요.'.                    
*      GV_RESULT = 'X'.                                
*      EXIT.                                   &nb
*    WHEN 1.                                    &n
*      "SKIP                                   &nb
*    WHEN OTHERS.                                   &nb
*      MESSAGE S000(ZDTV3M) DISPLAY LIKE 'W' WITH '한 행만 선택하세요.'.                    &
*      GV_RESULT = 'X'.                                
*      EXIT.                                   &nb
*  ENDCASE.                                       
*                                          &n
*  READ TABLE LT_ROWS INTO LS_ROWS INDEX 1.                            &nbs
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR L_SEQ.                                     &nb
*  LOOP AT IT_INV_GOOD.                                   &n
*    IF IT_INV_GOOD-GOOD_SEQ = LS_ROWS-INDEX.                             &
*      DELETE IT_INV_GOOD.                                &n
*      CONTINUE.                                   
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      L_SEQ = L_SEQ + 1.                              
*      IT_INV_GOOD-GOOD_SEQ = L_SEQ.                              
*      MODIFY IT_INV_GOOD TRANSPORTING GOOD_SEQ.                           
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDLOOP.                                       
*                                          &n
*ENDFORM.
